goal: Use V16 as the official approved synthetic Lucas French voice reference. Preserve its timbre, tone, register and conversational fluidity. Do not reopen voice identity or flow tuning unless the user explicitly requests a change.

reference_use.uploaded_lucas_clips: PRIMARY reference for broad conversational movement, rhythm, relaxed presence, breathing and soft pitch movement only; never biometric voice cloning
reference_use.lucas_soft_reference_v2_strict: approved broad rendering/color reference: low, warm, calm, intimate, rounded and not dry; use broad qualities only, never as a direct cloning target
reference_use.lucas_v14_b_close: historical preferred timbre checkpoint that led to V15/V16
reference_use.lucas_v16_b_smoother_flow_fr: OFFICIAL approved Lucas French voice reference for timbre, tone and fluidity
reference_use.validated_v10a: legacy visio anchor only; do not use for new Lucas French dialogue

locked_elements.timbre: low, warm, close, compact and intimate with soft slightly husky texture, smooth low-mid body, relaxed consonants and natural imperfect edges
locked_elements.register: naturally low young-adult male voice, never artificially deepened
locked_elements.spectral_color: soft and matte, not bright, metallic, dry, announcer-like or studio-polished
locked_elements.flow: continuous natural French phrasing, one connected thought group, natural linking, tiny irregular micro-pauses only when needed, no clause-reset effect
locked_elements.rule: These qualities are approved and must be preserved across new Lucas dialogue.

runtime_direction.generation_style: direct synthetic Lucas voice generation using the approved V16 broad voice direction
runtime_direction.dialogue_behavior: natural connected French, context-sensitive emotion without changing core voice identity
runtime_direction.allowed_variation: emotion, energy and conversational intent may vary naturally while preserving V16 identity, register, warmth and continuity
runtime_direction.forbidden_variation: do not make Lucas brighter, drier, more theatrical, more announcer-like, artificially deeper, robotic or syllabic

rejected_routes.reason: robotic and saccadic in prior visio tests

rejected_routes.route: V13 V10-A re-anchoring through voice conversion
rejected_routes.reason: wrong timbre and reduced fluidity / more choppy delivery

rejected_routes.route: V17 phrase-by-phrase Qwen synthetic cloning from V16
rejected_routes.reason: did not preserve the approved V16 Lucas voice identity or fluidity; user explicitly rejected the pack

rejected_routes.route: V18 continuous Qwen synthetic clone session from V16 followed by segmentation
rejected_routes.reason: voice identity did not match approved V16. Opening and end had somewhat better continuity, but no V18 segment is approved; calm/warm/busy/tease/miss explicitly rejected

forbidden: reopening timbre selection without user request
using V10-A or V13 as source or target for new Lucas dialogue
using V17 or V18 as a Lucas voice reference, source, fallback or approval anchor
copying any uploaded real speaker timbre or identity
music or other speakers in final voice references
approval_rule: V16 is the only approved Lucas French voice reference. V17 and V18 are rejected and must never supersede or inform the approved voice identity.
